answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a violet bet on surviving 70 epochs of grading, and every dune settlement recomputes the vault schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 70 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
